purpose: Execute the three machine-executable sub-questions of factory direction v25 at full corpus density, autonomously, because legal-distance 174k representations have NOT landed in accepted state while accepted-state 174k TF-IDF embeddings (fractal-map legal_tfidf_embeddings, 175440x128) LACK a row-order provenance map (both metadata_174k_full.json and metadata_175k_full.json in the accepted mount contain only the 21,228-entry local subset). The evaluation lane therefore reconstructs the zero-shot TF-IDF production family from the PINNED corpus parquet (same source the fractal-map accepted embeddings derive from), with a PROVABLE row order equal to the frozen evaluation metadata, and evaluates it with frozen harness v3 thresholds unchanged.

sample.source: evaluation/data/174k/metadata_174k.json (173,963 decisions, derived from pinned parquet)
sample.inclusion_rule: decision_id must be present in BOTH frozen metadata AND the regenerated pinned-parquet corpus (recorded as actual_n at build time; no filtering after embedding build)

representations.note: Zero-shot TF-IDF production family, pipeline parameters FROZEN from accepted v16 suite / fractal-map accepted legal_tfidf_embeddings metadata; deterministic (seed 42); all outputs L2-normalized, 128-dim after TruncatedSVD.
representations.empty_row_rule: TF-IDF fit on non-empty rows only; zero vectors scattered to empty rows (frozen v16 semantics)

benchmarks.suite: 12-benchmark formal suite (frozen v16 spec, config hash 4323f833fa72366a; thresholds UNCHANGED)

dedicated_citation_heritage.pair_pool: evaluation/results/174k_citation_heritage/citation_pairs_174k_full.json (137,314 positive + 137,314 negative, built from published 2,019/2,105 citation-ID resolution)

v17b_label_normalization.comparison: raw legal_area labels vs normalized labels on hierarchy_coherence + zoom_coherence + legal_area_clustering; success rule: no representation worsened by more than 10% on any hierarchy-family metric at 174k (mirrors v17b 1200-scale uniformity rule)

scale_adaptations_frozen.nn_backend: hnswlib (M=16, ef_construction=200, ef_search=100) for k-NN at n>10000; exact-cosine parity with frozen harness established in accepted full-corpus harness validation (config hash 4047da047fb339c1)
scale_adaptations_frozen.temporal_stability_splits: 5 shuffled splits of a FIXED 30,000-row subsample (seed 42); per-split dedicated HNSW index on the subsample
scale_adaptations_frozen.hierarchy_family_sample: FIXED 15,000-decision subsample stratified by branch (seed 42) among decisions with known legal_area; used for hierarchy_coherence, zoom_coherence, legal_area_clustering
scale_adaptations_frozen.boilerplate_pairs: 200 random decision pairs (seed 42), texts from regenerated pinned-parquet corpus
scale_adaptations_frozen.no_tuning_rule: No threshold, k, sample or pipeline parameter is adjusted after results are observed.

success_rules: Sub-question 1: per-representation verdicts on the 12-benchmark suite with frozen thresholds, reported without tuning.
Sub-question 2: per-representation AUC-ROC on the frozen 137,314-pair citation pool, threshold >= 0.65.
Sub-question 3: v17b normalized-label purity ratios at 174k; generalization claim only if no representation worsens by >10% on hierarchy-family metrics.
evidence_refs_frozen: evaluation/run_full_corpus_evaluation.py + evaluation/scalable_nn.py (HNSW scale path, config hash 4047da047fb339c1)
/tmp/opencode/lexcorpus2/parquet/bger.parquet (pinned parquet, SHA-256 verified by corpus lane manifest)
